$comment: GENERATED by apps/curation/scripts/emit-chip-sets.mjs — do not edit. Source of truth: apps/curation/src/features/audit/dispositionChips.ts. 'added' is the UTC timestamp (seconds, not days) a chip was first offered in that set; filter on it before reading 'offered but never picked', since a chip younger than the dispositions being tallied cannot have been refused. Seconds matter: six chips landed 4h after their dialog's last disposition on the SAME DATE. It is commit time, so 'added after the row' is conclusive and 'added before' means only that exposure was possible.

CAL_EXTRA_ACCEPT_CHIPS.help: strong evidence in the paper or data

CAL_EXTRA_ACCEPT_CHIPS.label: Accepted with reservation
CAL_EXTRA_ACCEPT_CHIPS.help: keeping it, but it isn't the ideal form — partial credit, or it would be better as an S-P-O statement, or a more specific term exists. Say which in the note.

CAL_EXTRA_ACCEPT_CHIPS.label: Fills gap
CAL_EXTRA_ACCEPT_CHIPS.help: adds information absent from current gold

CAL_EXTRA_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Already covered
CAL_EXTRA_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: an existing factor / tag / characteristic already captures this

CAL_EXTRA_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Wrong shape
CAL_EXTRA_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: the axis is real but the agent's partition / FV breakdown doesn't match the experiment

CAL_EXTRA_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: FVs need work
CAL_EXTRA_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: would add but the FV labels need work — want a redo, not as-is

CAL_EXTRA_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: No evidence
CAL_EXTRA_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: no supporting evidence in the paper/data

CAL_EXTRA_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Out of scope
CAL_EXTRA_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: outside the scope of this factor category

CAL_EXTRA_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Borderline
CAL_EXTRA_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: close call — could reasonably go either way

CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Redundant / already covered
CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: the term is already captured elsewhere — by a biomaterial characteristic, a fully-covering factor value, or another tag

CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Badly wrong
CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: not a valid annotation — the category isn't a Gemma EFC (region / condition / passage / karyotype …), or the value belongs to a different category entirely (a chemical under genotype)

CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Aboutism
CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: a claim about what the study is ABOUT, not a feature of the profiled samples — the tags guideline's "don't tag claims from the abstract"

CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Correct but out of scope
CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: true of the samples, but not something we curate here — the agent's modelling is fine, the scope rule is what it missed

CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: No evidence
CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: no supporting evidence in the paper/data

CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Subset only
CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: applies to only a subset of profiled samples (e.g., case half of a case/control study)

CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Wrong
CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: well-formed, but not true of these samples — the agent picked an incorrect term or value

CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Right value, wrong category
CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: the value is correct but filed under the wrong EFC — recategorise rather than drop

CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Wrong and out of scope
CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: neither true nor in scope — no credit either way

CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Borderline
CAL_EXTRA_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: genuinely a close call — prefer one of the specific reasons above where one fits

CAL_MISS_ACCEPT_CHIPS.label: Current wrong
CAL_MISS_ACCEPT_CHIPS.help: the current tag is incorrect or outdated — agent's removal is right

CAL_MISS_ACCEPT_CHIPS.label: Current redundant
CAL_MISS_ACCEPT_CHIPS.help: the current tag is already captured elsewhere — by a biomaterial characteristic, a factor value, or another tag

CAL_MISS_ACCEPT_CHIPS.label: Aboutism
CAL_MISS_ACCEPT_CHIPS.help: a claim about what the study is ABOUT, not a feature of the profiled samples — the tags guideline's "don't tag claims from the abstract". Removing it is right.

CAL_MISS_ACCEPT_CHIPS.label: More specific available
CAL_MISS_ACCEPT_CHIPS.help: agent's removal is right because a finer-grained tag better captures this (often paired with an add proposal elsewhere)

CAL_MISS_FACTOR_ACCEPT_CHIPS.label: Swapping with another proposal
CAL_MISS_FACTOR_ACCEPT_CHIPS.help: the same axis is being added by a different proposal — this removal is bookkeeping, not a judgement that the factor was wrong. NOT evidence the curated factor was incorrect.

CAL_MISS_FACTOR_ACCEPT_CHIPS.label: Partition wrong
CAL_MISS_FACTOR_ACCEPT_CHIPS.help: the factor's sample groupings are wrong — the axis may be real but this partition of the samples isn't

CAL_MISS_FACTOR_ACCEPT_CHIPS.label: Already covered
CAL_MISS_FACTOR_ACCEPT_CHIPS.help: another factor / tag / characteristic already captures this axis

CAL_MISS_FACTOR_ACCEPT_CHIPS.label: More specific available
CAL_MISS_FACTOR_ACCEPT_CHIPS.help: a finer-grained factor better captures this (usually paired with an add proposal elsewhere)

CAL_MISS_FACTOR_ACCEPT_CHIPS.label: Not a real axis
CAL_MISS_FACTOR_ACCEPT_CHIPS.help: the factor doesn't describe an experimental variable at all — the genuinely-remove-it case, and the rare one

CAL_MISS_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Factor is correct — keep it
CAL_MISS_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: the factor and its FVs are right as they stand; nothing needs fixing, the agent simply didn't propose it

CAL_MISS_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Keep it, but the FV labels need work
CAL_MISS_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: the factor's category is right — the FV labels / values are what need fixing

CAL_MISS_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Keep it, but the samples are grouped wrong
CAL_MISS_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: the factor's category is right — which samples sit in which FV is what needs fixing

CAL_MISS_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Keep it, but I'm not certain
CAL_MISS_FACTOR_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: keeping it on balance — the evidence doesn't quite settle the call. Say what's unresolved in the note.

CAL_MISS_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Tag is correct — keep it
CAL_MISS_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: the tag is right and applies as it stands; the agent simply proposed dropping it

CAL_MISS_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Keep it — it covers all the samples
CAL_MISS_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: the tag holds for every profiled sample — answers a 'subset only' rationale for removing it

CAL_MISS_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Keep it, but I'm not certain
CAL_MISS_TAG_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: keeping it on balance — the evidence doesn't quite settle whether it covers every sample. Say what's unresolved in the note.

FACTOR_MATCH_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: TMTOWTDI

FACTOR_MATCH_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Agent's is better — category

FACTOR_MATCH_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Equivalent
FACTOR_MATCH_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: same thing in a different surface form — NOT a disagreement. Distinct from keeping the current one, because for calibration this means the agent was right and was scored as a miss.

FACTOR_MATCH_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Neither is right
FACTOR_MATCH_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: both the agent's and the current version are wrong — the fix is a third thing

FACTOR_PARTITION_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: Want merge instead
FACTOR_PARTITION_DISMISS_CHIPS.help: adopt the agent's FVs into the existing factor without overwriting structure

FACTOR_PARTITION_DISMISS_CHIPS.label: TMTOWTDI
